brahmanbrahmavidāṃ śreṣṭheti
bhānukṛtaṃ brahmasaṃbodhanaṃ brahmakṛtaṃ vasiṣṭhasaṃbodhanaṃ ca

te
daśa brahmāṇaḥ prāguktā brāhmaṇā eva nānye iti sa bhānurbrahmaṇo mama pura
uktvā tūṣṇīmeva babhūvetyarthaḥ

śarīrātmakasyāvayavasanniveśasya tyāge rāge ahamabhimānena svīkṛtya
rañjane ca te bhāvo niṣkāmaḥ

kiṃcaitairaindavasargaistvaṃ svaputrapautrādīnāṃ saṃpadvṛddhidarśanādiva
yadi toṣameṣi tattarhi ete aindavā agre'pi sargāttaṃ toṣaśīlaṃ tvāṃ
toṣayiṣyantītyarthaḥ
astu toṣaḥ tathāpi matsargastena kuto na gatārthastatrāha - cittanetreṇeti
bhavānanyasya sarga cittarūpeṇa netreṇa paśyati dṛśā cakṣuṣā tu no paśyati

kastatsraṣṭā tu svakṛtaṃ sargaṃ mayedaṃ sṛṣṭamiti cakṣuṣaivāvaśyaṃ vetti
ataste svacakṣurdarśanārhaḥ sargo nānyena gatārtha ityarthaḥ
tarhyaindavakṛtasarga eva mayā cakṣuṣā draṣṭavyastatrāha - yenaiveti

yadyevaṃ tarhi vṛthā manmanasā dṛśyo'yamaindavasargo matpratikūla eveti
mayā nāśanīyastatrāha - na caitāniti
śāpena tarhi sa mayā nirasanīyastatrāha - bahukālamiti

ata eva hi mūḍhānāṃ saṃsāranivāraṇe
tadbodhanamevopāyo na varaśāpādiranya ityāha - tadbodhanāditi
